body:
## Accepted OOS Disposition

### OOS_1 (FINDING_5): cancelled-outline renderer-fail fallback marker ordering is under-tested
- **Disposition**: Inline-triage rule 2 — folded into current PR commit fd99e8c7; ~14 LOC test assertions added to skills/design/scripts/test-render-final-summary.sh renderer-fail block.

### OOS_2 (FINDING_14): unrelated readability commit increases PR surface
- **Disposition**: Rejected — commit c990683f is already on main (squash-merged PR #3051), not in this feature branch diff. Reviewer saw it in branch context but it is not a feature branch commit.

## Rejected / Out-of-Scope Observations (not filed)

### OOS_3 (FINDING_10): design RUN_ID validation may permit sentinel-disrupting session IDs — exonerated (pre-existing, not introduced by this PR)
### OOS_4 (FINDING_11): fallback output still exits successfully for machine consumers — neutral (no consensus to file)
### OOS_5 (FINDING_12): substring-only fallback detection could false-positive — exonerated
### OOS_6 (FINDING_4): pre-existing fallback composer duplication — exonerated (predates this change)
### OOS_7 (FINDING_8): pre-publish renderer-failure fallback path is not covered — exonerated (plan scoped to post-publish)
### OOS_8 (FINDING_9): Bash 3.2 harness does not assert fallback contract — exonerated (harness checks pass behavior, renderer failure is not in its scope)
